baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَتَحَاجُّونَ ... إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا ... فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Reciprocal contention turns former following into a claim: because the weak trailed the self-exalting party, they ask that party to stand in for them and absorb an assigned share of the fire. Followership is thus recast from obedience into an attached liability.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing proof and contest supply the literal force of reciprocal contention and make the speech a claim rather than a bare cry.
Trailing and obeying supply the concrete relation on which the weak base their claim.
An attached consequence or liability makes followership carry a claim back toward the followed party.
Sufficing and standing in for another supply the requested substitution.
A designated share supplies the portion of punishment that the weak try to transfer.

changed_reading.before: The weak simply beg their former superiors for some relief.
changed_reading.after: The weak litigate followership as delegated liability, asking their former leaders to substitute for them in an allocated share of fire.

baseline_models.mechanism: The labels preserve a vertical social contrast, but both groups now occupy the same fire. The weak test whether self-magnification ever amounted to real capacity; inability to relieve them collapses the old hierarchy from operative authority into an exposed posture.

activation_trace.role: Lack of strength supplies the lower party's former dependency and present need.
Self-exaltation supplies the claimed height whose practical worth is being tested.
The burning fire is both shared enclosure and the burden from which the old rank cannot protect anyone.
Capacity to suffice another is the operational test that the supposedly greater party must meet.

changed_reading.before: Weak and arrogant remain stable ranks even after punishment begins.
changed_reading.after: Shared enclosure turns arrogance into a failed capacity claim: the old superiors retain their label but no longer possess a functioning superiority.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier disputation is an outward coalition tactic: falsehood is twisted into argument to make truth lose its footing. In the focus ayah the same adversarial energy has folded inward, and followers now use the hierarchy itself as evidence against former leaders.

activation_trace.role: Argument by competing proofs anchors the focus scene as an internal contest of claims.
Twisted adversarial contention supplies the earlier outward polemical mechanism that later turns upon its own coalition.
Loss of truth and stability identifies the defective material used in the earlier contention.
The fall and invalidation of an argument supply the intended operation of the earlier polemic.
Stable reality opposed to falsehood supplies the resistant object that the coalition had tried to dislodge.
The liability attached to following becomes the new internal subject of contention.

structural_cues: 40:4-5 place disputation against the signs and give it the purpose of dislodging truth.
40:47 changes both arena and parties: reciprocal contention occurs inside the fire between former allies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier outward falsehood-to-displacement sequence and the later reciprocal contention; I infer a reversal in which the coalition's polemical machinery internalizes. A live alternative is simple thematic repetition of disputation without a causal reversal.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a post-disaster quarrel unrelated to the coalition's former argumentative practice.
changed_reading.after: The coalition's old polemic folds inward: followers now prosecute leaders with the very social relation that had sustained the shared front.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah makes following a routed act: one speaker says to follow him so that he may guide to a path, then contrasts his call to rescue with their call to fire. The focus statement 'we were followers of you' therefore functions as a traceable route accusation, and the requested share is sent back along the invitation chain.

activation_trace.role: Trailing and obeying anchor the focus claim in an actual relation of following.
The explicit command to follow supplies a contrasting model in which a follower is led somewhere.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies the leader-to-route function implicit in following.
An extended traversed road supplies the destination-bearing geometry of the relation.
Calling and drawing by speech supply the opposed invitations that recruit people toward rescue or fire.
Rescue by separation supplies the destination opposed to the shared enclosure.
Burning fire supplies the destination to which the counter-call draws its hearers.

structural_cues: 40:38 binds the imperative 'follow me' directly to 'I will guide you to the path of right direction.'
40:41 balances 'I call you to rescue' against 'you call me to the fire.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, guidance, path, and opposed invitations; I assign the arrow from invitation and route-setting to accountable influence. The materially live alternative is that followers remain responsible choosers and invoke the route only as a retrospective excuse.

changed_reading.before: The followers cite only their subordinate social status.
changed_reading.after: They identify the arrogant as route-setters who drew them toward fire, then return the cost of that route to its former guides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent reply concedes common presence in the fire and invokes a judgment made between the servants. Judgment separates claims and fixes parties even inside a shared enclosure, so the leaders cannot convert co-presence into capacity to absorb another's allotted share.

activation_trace.role: Sufficing or standing in for another supplies the transfer that the question tests.
An assigned share supplies the already apportioned object of the attempted transfer.
The same self-exalting party is preserved as speaker while its inability is openly conceded.
Judgment between people supplies the authoritative settlement that supersedes former social command.
Separation and distinction supply the boundary between parties and their liabilities despite shared location.

structural_cues: 40:48 is the direct response to the focus question and begins by conceding that all are in the fire.
The reply ends with the completed judgment 'قد حكم بين العباد,' shifting authority away from the former leaders.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the request for substitution, the adjacent answer, and completed judgment between parties; I infer that final allocation blocks transfer. A live alternative is that 'all are in it' asserts only equal helplessness without specifying non-transferability.

changed_reading.before: The question leaves open whether the leaders retain enough power to reduce or absorb another's punishment.
changed_reading.after: The question tests whether old hierarchy can override settled apportionment, and the adjacent answer says that shared punishment does not create transferable liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: After leaders fail to offset a share, the inhabitants redirect the appeal to custodians and shrink it to lightening one day of punishment; the custodians then send them back to prayer. The focus is the first handoff in a collapsing delegation ladder that progressively strips away imagined intermediaries.

activation_trace.role: Standing in for another supplies the first attempted delegation of relief.
The requested share supplies the first unit of relief in the descending sequence.
A custodian charged with preservation supplies the next imagined intermediary after the leaders fail.
Calling by speech supplies the inhabitants' attempt to make the custodians relay their appeal.
Lightening a weight supplies the reduced form of relief now requested.
Painful punishment supplies the burden whose quantity and duration they try to reduce.
The repeated call returns the speakers to their own futile appeal, closing the intermediary handoff.

structural_cues: 40:49 changes the addressee from the arrogant to the keepers and changes the requested unit from a share to one day.
40:50 refuses mediation, sends the inhabitants back to calling, and closes by locating the disbelievers' call in loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent appeals to leaders and keepers, a shrinking request, and a return to direct calling; I infer a staged collapse of delegated rescue. A live alternative is that the appeals are merely successive desperation without a designed intermediary ladder.

changed_reading.before: The weak make one isolated and possibly workable appeal to their former leaders.
changed_reading.after: Their question begins a serial failure of delegated rescue: leader, custodian, and petition each prove unable to shift the burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the surah's close, greater numbers, concentrated strength, and accumulated earnings are explicitly audited and found unable to avail their holders. The focus question therefore sounds less like hope in elite capacity than a test exposing that self-enlargement has no redeeming capital.

activation_trace.role: Self-exaltation supplies the leaders' claimed magnitude and presumed reserve of capacity.
Capacity to suffice another is the exact quality put under audit.
Growth in number supplies one form of apparently superior collective capital.
Concentrated strength like strands of a rope supplies another form of apparent capacity.
The exact recurrence of availing declares that such capital did not suffice its holders.
Acquired gain supplies the stored resource that nevertheless fails to protect.

structural_cues: 40:82 coordinates being more numerous, being stronger, and possessing آثار before stating that earnings did not avail them.
The exact غ ن ي recurrence answers the focus wording 'فهل أنتم مغنون عنا' at the level of capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact availing-root recurrence inside an audit of number, strength, and earnings; I infer that the leaders' social magnitude is treated as bankrupt capital. A live alternative is that 40:82 concerns historical peoples generally and only echoes, rather than answers, the focus question.

changed_reading.before: The weak may still believe that former elites possess a reserve capable of buying partial relief.
changed_reading.after: Their wording audits a reserve already exposed as worthless: magnitude, strength, and acquisition cannot suffice even their holders, much less their followers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah moves from repeated presentation before the fire to a command of entry at the Hour; the focus then locates the parties inside it. Their contention is the first social action staged after spectacle becomes enclosure, so the quarrel marks a threshold crossing rather than a static punishment tableau.

activation_trace.role: The burning fire supplies the object before which the people are repeatedly presented.
Bringing something forth for view supplies the pre-entry stage of exposure.
Passage into an interior supplies the explicit threshold transition at the Hour.
Painful punishment supplies the intensified destination of the entry command.
The repeated focus occurrence makes the fire both present interior and requested transferable burden.

structural_cues: 40:46 contrasts habitual presentation 'غدوا وعشيا' with the Hour's command 'أدخلوا.'
40:47 immediately opens with 'وإذ يتحاجون في النار,' changing relation to the fire from عليها to في.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies presentation toward the fire, commanded entry, and then contention inside it; I infer a threshold sequence in which enclosure activates the social reckoning. A live alternative is that these are punishment stages without a causal link between entry and argument.

changed_reading.before: The argument is an undifferentiated scene somewhere within punishment.
changed_reading.after: The argument marks the threshold at which repeated exposure has become irreversible interiority and former social arrangements are forced to reckon with one another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes a social noun through later punishment imagery and does not establish lexical identity. It remains anchored in تَبَعًا and the shared fire while 40:71 supplies collars, connected links, and dragging; downstream prose should present it only as a suggestive spatial echo.

activation_trace.role: Unbroken succession supplies a latent geometry in which one party continues after another.
A collar that binds the limb supplies the bodily fastening of the sequence.
Connected rings and parts supply a material analogue for socially linked followers.
Dragging and extending supply the forced motion of linked bodies toward the fire.
The burning fire anchors the social and material sequences in the same destination.

changed_reading.before: Following is only a past social relation invoked in speech.
changed_reading.after: Suggestively, following becomes a bodily chain geometry: linked dependents are dragged in succession into the destination produced by their former attachment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because an ordinary نصيب is an abstract allotted share, not necessarily a physical boundary. It remains focus-anchored through the share, the enclosing argument, and the repeated fire; downstream prose should qualify the marked-off sector as a spatial visualization of apportionment, not a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَتَحَاجُّونَ فِي النَّارِ ... نَصِيبًا مِنَ النَّارِ

activation_trace.role: A surrounding rim supplies an exploratory enclosure within which shares could be spatially distinguished.
An erected boundary marker supplies the exploratory image of a marked-off quota.
The ordinary assigned share keeps the spatial image attached to the actual request.
Standing in for another supplies the proposed occupation or absorption of that quota.
The repeated burning fire supplies both the containing field and the substance being apportioned.

changed_reading.before: The requested share is only an abstract quantity of punishment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the share appears as a marked-off sector within a common fiery enclosure that the former leaders are asked to occupy or absorb.

strongest_changes: The focus plea became a liability claim built from following, substitution, and an assigned share.
The route and invitation sequence in 40:38-41 made followership an accusation against those who directed others toward fire.
The direct answer in 40:48 made completed judgment, rather than former rank, the controlling allocation.
The appeals in 40:49-50 exposed the focus as the first failed handoff in a collapsing delegation ladder.
The exact غ ن ي recurrence in 40:82 turned elite strength and acquisition into bankrupt protective capital.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly converted social hierarchy into route, allocation, and failed substitution. The adjacent reply and the later exact availing-root recurrence made the focus read as a capacity audit rather than a generic quarrel.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax leaves open whether the weak ask leaders to absorb part of the fire themselves or to reduce it by some other means.
Route-setting supports causal accountability, but the followers may also be offering a retrospective excuse for their own choice.
The chained-following and bounded-quota readings are material analogies, not primary lexical senses.
